newsitem.title: UK: EMI shares fall after large sell order.
newsitem.headline: EMI shares fall after large sell order.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc fell on Thursday, depressed by a large sell order, dealers said.
By 1524 GMT, shares in the record company were down 12-1/2p at 12.60 stg in a firmer market.
"There was no news but there was one big seller," one market-maker said.

"These shares have a big bid premium and it doesn't take a lot for them to come off," another said. "There has been some lingering disappointment they didn't have a hit single over Christmas and maybe that has affected sentiment."
EMI shares have pushed higher in recent months on speculation that the company was a likely candisate for a merger or takeover bid.
